positions.name: AtlasRollbackRehearsalCommitment
positions.frame: What does the standing commitment to Atlas rollback rehearsals consist of — how often they run, and who owns them?
positions.why: Quinton's directive sets the practice ('run monthly from now on') and grounds it in a maxim about rehearsed rollbacks being the only rollbacks actually held; Xena's two bullet fields restate the same commitment's cadence and owner. The set holds a conviction gradient — the directive performs the settling, the bullets only record it — but all three read under one frame: the shape of the rehearsal commitment, its cadence, and its owner.
